stories.title: Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work
stories.simple_summary: A new company called Model ML raised 250 million dollars to build AI helpers that do boring paperwork for investment bankers. These AI helpers update financial documents automatically when deals change.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and large financial companies. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases
stories.simple_summary: Google is making its Gemini AI helper able to do more tasks like making phone calls, logging into websites, and buying things for you on your behalf.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Google's AI assistant, you'll soon be able to ask it to handle some shopping and administrative tasks without doing them yourself.

stories.title: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free
stories.simple_summary: Google renamed its AI helper called Spark to Tasks and made it free for everyone. It can create meal plans, organize your calendar, and help you find subscriptions you might not need anymore.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have a Google account, you can now use a helpful AI assistant at no cost to manage daily tasks and find ways to save money.

stories.title: Google to keep Gemini chats for 2 months, up from 72 hours, even with history off
stories.simple_summary: Google is keeping your chat conversations with its Gemini AI for two months instead of deleting them after three days. This happens even if you turn off chat history.
stories.why_it_matters: Google will store your conversations longer now. If you care about privacy, be aware that your chats with this AI tool are kept around longer than before.

stories.title: As decision model use skyrockets, is customization the next frontier?
stories.simple_summary: A company called Sqwish Labs is working on AI that you can train using your own business information to make it work better for your specific needs.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers and large companies experimenting with AI. There's nothing you need to do right now.

stories.title: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
stories.simple_summary: Pedestal AI raised 4.7 million dollars to build AI helpers that make supply chains faster and more reliable. A supply chain is the system that moves products from factories to stores.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mostly to large manufacturers and retailers. Regular customers might eventually get products faster, but no immediate action is needed on your part.

stories.title: Proton’s Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
stories.simple_summary: A company called Proton made a new privacy-focused AI assistant called Lumo that you can use on Windows, Mac, and Linux computers. It competes with popular AI tools like ChatGPT and focuses on protecting your privacy.
stories.why_it_matters: If you care a lot about privacy and want to use AI, this gives you another option that limits how much personal information the AI can see.

stories.title: AI models can be tricked into identifying civilians as military targets by telling them it’s a game
stories.simple_summary: Researchers tested whether leading AI tools could be tricked into helping with military targeting by disguising it as a game. The AI tools often agreed to do it.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a serious safety concern for the future. It shows that AI can be manipulated in dangerous ways, which governments and AI companies need to address.

stories.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO
stories.simple_summary: Jensen Huang, who founded the chip company Nvidia, recently resigned but just said he would be happy to come back as CEO if the board asks him to.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to Nvidia investors. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Daydream’s new AI agent acts as your personal stylist — and can shop for you, too
stories.simple_summary: A new AI tool called Daydream acts like a personal fashion helper. It can remember your style, let you virtually try on clothes, suggest outfits, and buy things for you.
stories.why_it_matters: If you like online shopping and clothing, you could use this to get outfit suggestions and try things on before buying, saving you time and money.

stories.title: The DOJ says it’s investigating Megaspeed
stories.simple_summary: The U.S. Department of Justice and Commerce Department announced they are investigating Megaspeed, a data center company in Singapore that is connected to the recent resignation of Nvidia's CEO.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a legal investigation that mostly affects large companies and investors. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Jensen Huang says he’s willing to return as Nvidia CEO
stories.simple_summary: Jensen Huang, who resigned as Nvidia's CEO last week, stated publicly that he would be willing to return as CEO if the company's board wants him back.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to Nvidia investors and employees. There's nothing you need to do.
